review:
Queen Aisha's jungle on 5x3 with a classic hold-and-win. Three coin or jackpot orbs trigger it, then only orbs, Jaguar Multipliers and blanks land, and each orb sticks and resets your three lives.

At the end, coin orbs pay their values and jackpot orbs pay one of five jackpots. Jaguar Multipliers boost every coin already on the board and refill your lives. Medium volatility, 2,500x max, 96.19% RTP. Mainstream hold-and-win, Hacksaw style.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 86.28% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
